summary: IEEE-library form of minute-pulse clock contact: this representation identifies the publisher's normally-open clock contact that closes every minute.
description: This reference locates minute-pulse clock contact in Autodesk's IEEE-oriented instrumentation and sensors family. This representation identifies the publisher's normally-open clock contact that closes every minute. The public library uses HIN1P33 for its horizontal representation; this is a vendor block name, not an IEEE standards symbol number.
